title: Grandstream GRP2611G Basic HD IP Phone With Adapter

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GRP2611G Basic HD IP Phone with Adapter is a powerful carrier-grade VoIP desk phone designed for businesses, offices, call centers, and enterprise communication systems. It delivers high-performance networking with Gigabit speed, HD voice quality, and advanced security features, making it ideal for modern communication environments.


As part of Grandstream’s professional GRP series, the GRP2611G supports centralized cloud management through GDMS, zero-touch provisioning, and scalable deployment for IT administrators. With its sleek design, color LCD display, and flexible connectivity options, it is a perfect solution for growing businesses.


Buy the original Grandstream GRP2611G Basic HD IP Phone with Adapter from D CORE at the best price in Bangladesh.


Key Features


  • Supports 2 SIP accounts and 2 lines
  • Gigabit dual Ethernet ports (10/100/1000 Mbps)
  • 2.8-inch color LCD display
  • HD audio on handset and speakerphone
  • 5-way audio conferencing support
  • Integrated PoE support (802.3af)
  • Noise Shield technology for background noise reduction
  • Electronic Hook Switch (EHS) support
  • Secure boot, encrypted storage, and TLS/SRTP security
  • GDMS cloud provisioning and centralized management
  • Wall-mountable design
  • Customizable faceplate for branding
